Use the provenance-rich join path molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. INNER JOIN compound_structures to enforce the SMILES requirement. Filter by target CHEMBL1978 and standard_type IC50. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication.
